  "solution_outline": [
    "Create /app/normalize.py with the normalize function",
    "Phase 1: s = address.strip()",
    "Phase 2: s = re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s)  — collapse whitespace",
    "Phase 3: s = s.upper()",
    "Phase 4: s = re.sub(r'[.,]', '', s)  — remove periods and commas",
    "Phase 5: s = re.sub(r'\\b0+(\\d+)\\b', r'\\1', s)  — strip leading zeros from standalone numbers",
    "Phase 6: s = re.sub(r'#+\\s*', '# ', s)  — normalise hash/pound to '# '",
    "Phase 7: s = re.sub(r'(\\d+)\\s+ST\\s+(?=[A-Z])', r'\\1 SAINT ', s)  — SAINT disambiguation",
    "Phase 8: s = re.sub(r'\\bP\\s*O\\s+BOX\\b', 'PO BOX', s); s = re.sub(r'\\bPOST\\s+OFFICE\\s+BOX\\b', 'PO BOX', s)",
    "Phase 9: Expand directionals — NE→NORTHEAST, NW→NORTHWEST, SE→SOUTHEAST, SW→SOUTHWEST (two-letter first), then N→NORTH, S→SOUTH, E→EAST, W→WEST",
    "Phase 10: Expand street types — longer abbreviations first: PKWY→PARKWAY, BLVD→BOULEVARD, STR→STREET, TERR→TERRACE, DRV→DRIVE, CIR→CIRCLE, HWY→HIGHWAY, FWY→FREEWAY, TRL→TRAIL, AVE→AVENUE, TER→TERRACE, AV→AVENUE, ST→STREET, DR→DRIVE, RD→ROAD, LN→LANE, CT→COURT, PL→PLACE, SQ→SQUARE",
    "Phase 11: Expand units — BLDG→BUILDING, APT→APARTMENT, STE→SUITE, SU→SUITE, FL→FLOOR, RM→ROOM",
    "Phase 12: s = re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s); s = s.strip()  — final whitespace cleanup",
    "Return s"
  ],
